2026-09-14TCFinancial Administration ActAppointment of a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc.Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Transport of Karen McCarthy of Portugal Cove-St. Philip's, Newfoundland and Labrador, to be a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc., to hold office during pleasure for a term of three years, in the place of Ann-Margret White, whose term has expired.N/A
subject: Appointment of a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc.
precis: Approval of the appointment by the Minister of Transport of Karen McCarthy of Portugal Cove-St. Philip's, Newfoundland and Labrador, to be a director of the Board of Directors of Marine Atlantic Inc., to hold office during pleasure for a term of three years, in the place of Ann-Margret White, whose term has expired.
